title: BuildingOS Rules Document frontmatter
description: BuildingOS Rules (the constitution: behavior boundaries and constraints) frontmatter schema (M0 draft). Compiles to Codex (hierarchical AGENTS.md sections / AGENTS.override.md) and DSH (system-prompt sections + sandbox/approval knobs). Based on docs/api-contract.md Appendix A.

id.description: Rule identifier. kebab-case, unique within the tenant.

title.description: Rule title; maps to the Codex AGENTS.md section heading / DSH section name.

description.description: Rule purpose note (into index and review; not necessarily into the model prompt).

enforce.description: hard = must carry a permission fragment; compile derives runtime.yaml permissions (generative, Q1 settled). soft = prompt guidance only.

resource.description: Resource pattern, sharing the runtime.yaml permissions vocabulary (e.g., write:router, data:*:external).

permission.description: Machine-readable permission fragment (Q1 settled: generative). Required when enforce is hard; co-existing with enforce: soft is a lint error (CI cross-check).

order.description: Assembly order, lower first; one global numbering space (D20): shared with prompts, duplicates rejected by lint. AGENTS.md section order / DSH section order.

applies-to.description: Applicable surface (e.g., ops-engineer). Reserved in M0, compile ignores (Q3 settled); on import, a Codex subdirectory AGENTS.md maps to its directory name.

references.description: Related document paths (existence verified by lint).
